opening.argument: The promotion presents BitClub Network Bitcoin mining as a small investment for “Small Investment & Life time Passive Income” and assures viewers, “This is a genuine mining earnings.” It directs viewers into a registration flow that collects contact and profile information, with account credentials, personal-information fields, and a named sponsor. The upgrade page then presents a $99 membership invoice and Bitcoin payment instructions, while the enrollment invoice offers training about Bitcoin mining and the ability to purchase shares in profitable Bitcoin mines. These observable features connect the passive-earnings promise to a concrete paid mining solicitation. The records do not establish that payment was completed, information was misused, or earnings were delivered.
